title: The report's document fingerprint is stable for the same document (backlog DB-282): run_identity.document_fingerprint also leaves out the two per-run ids the live results route mints (option_id, study_id), beside results_id and computed_at, so re-running the same request reproduces the fingerprint while any real value change still moves it
objective: In services/api/app/drawings/report/run_identity.py extend _FINGERPRINT_EXCLUDE from (results_id, computed_at) to (results_id, computed_at, option_id, study_id) and correct the two prose places that list the excluded fields (the module docstring and the comment above the tuple). A read-only check (session-2026-10-15b/return-check-fingerprint.md) built the benchmark results document twice through the live route and diffed every leaf: exactly four top-level fields differ between runs (computed_at, results_id, option_id, study_id; the last two are uuid4 values minted per run in results_read.py), and no zoning value differs. The fixture tests never saw it because the recorded fixture carries fixed placeholder ids. Tests in services/api/tests/drawings/report/test_report_run_identity.py: one per input state (only the four run fields differ: same fingerprint; a real value differs: different fingerprint; a document without option_id or study_id: unchanged behaviour), a live two-run test through the TestClient results route with the benchmark providers (same fingerprint twice), and a mutation (the two-field tuple turns the new tests red). No other file changes; no value, label or text on any page changes except that the fingerprint is now reproducible.
business_reason: The owner's provenance rows ask the report to identify what generated it (R028) and to prove its results and diagrams come from one document (R058). The builder of M5-T189 and the orchestrator's prints saw the fingerprint change on every print of the same property (ffab545ea162, efb2e8145ae6, 7a1bd4c24f11), so the fingerprint proved nothing across prints.

acceptance_scenarios.given: two results documents that differ only in results_id, computed_at, option_id and study_id
two results documents that differ in one real value (an answer value, a floor area, a status)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the fingerprints differ (the existing sensitivity test stays green)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a document without option_id or study_id (older documents, synthetic fixtures)
acceptance_scenarios.then: it behaves exactly as before for that document

acceptance_scenarios.given: the live results route through the TestClient with benchmark_provider(with_zoning_lot=True, street_on=True), run twice
acceptance_scenarios.when: the fingerprint of each returned document is computed
acceptance_scenarios.then: the two are equal; mutation: with the old two-field tuple they differ and S1 and S4 fail

acceptance_scenarios.given: the module docstring and the comment above _FINGERPRINT_EXCLUDE
acceptance_scenarios.then: they list the four excluded run fields and say why (per-run metadata, not values)

risks: RISK 1: a deny-list fits contract 1.5.0 as emitted; a future contract that adds another per-run id or timestamp would bring the drift back. S4's live two-run test catches that the day it happens.

RISK 2: page_evidence.py's _run_identity docstring may name the excluded fields; it is outside this task (wording only) and stays as is unless it is wrong: if it lists only two fields, report it for the next task that edits that file.
path_notes: Small, independent hardening found in wave 28 (backlog DB-282). Neither file is pinned by an evidence record or the zoning-rule review register (checked by the read-only check). No test pins a literal fingerprint value. Runs beside M5-T172 (no shared file) and after M5-T189 (no shared file).
